audit_contract.purpose: Determine whether current local assets can define a hash-bound, source-only semantic authority covering all 19 ScanNet OVS classes without invoking a new foundation model.

semantic_authority_audit.sens_is_not_semantic_authority: The mounted .sens streams provide registered RGB/depth/camera observations but do not provide the official raw-label-to-NYU40 semantic chain.
semantic_authority_audit.historical_materialized_sidecars: Referenced under /root/RADIO-GS/local_ssd_results/source_post_spatial_text_posterior_v2, but that local-SSD authority is absent on this host and therefore cannot be revalidated or reused.
semantic_authority_audit.agile3d_fallback: The available PLY label property is an instance identifier. The local object_ids/object_classes mapping contains zero entries for all six eligible clean source scenes, so it cannot convert these registered fields into semantic authority.

historical_coverage.qualification: This proves the old three-scene fit authority was not class-complete; it does not imply that the currently unlabeled six-scene union covers the remaining classes.

conditional_execution_decision.reason: Class labels and hence 19-class coverage are not independently observable from the mounted eligible source assets. Constructing a split or fitting a calibrator would silently substitute an unverified authority.

minimum_completion_path: Restore the four official semantic-chain assets for the six clean source scenes and record content hashes before conversion.
Run the existing source-region semantic adapter to produce mesh/region-to-NYU40 sidecars bound to the registered geometry and factorized-field hashes.
Perform a label-only union-coverage scan over source scenes; require nonzero support for every one of the 19 evaluation classes.

If the six-scene union is incomplete, select the smallest additional independent ScanNet train scenes that close coverage, then require their registered geometry and compatible field assets before proceeding.
Freeze a class-complete fit/development split and execute scene-disjoint LOSO identifiability gates before any paper8 evaluation or calibration promotion.

cost_boundary.if_official_annotations_for_existing_six: No new foundation model is required. The remaining work is CPU-side annotation conversion, geometry association, hash/manifest I/O, coverage counting, and LOSO training/evaluation.
cost_boundary.if_existing_six_do_not_cover_all_19_clas: Additional source scenes are required. Annotation-only coverage selection is cheap, but scenes lacking already-compatible registered fields create a material extraction/field-build cost and cannot be filled by metric tuning.

conclusion: The host has six usable independent source geometry/field carriers, but not a locally verifiable class-complete semantic authority. The high-value next action is restoring and hash-binding official source annotations, not another category calibration variant.
